Try the same action in both working versions: choose **Name A–Z** in the [menu version](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=sort&control=menu), then choose **Name A–Z** in the [button version](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=sort&control=buttons). Which feels more natural for everyday use?

Both versions assume ordering changes immediately, supports newest, oldest, and name, and only rearranges the visible cards without altering them.
